ForgeDock · <ver>
GitHub as a knowledge graph for AI agents
Unknown command: nosuchcommand
New to ForgeDock? npx forgedock guide explains the workflow in one screen.

╭───────────────────────────────────────────── Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Command                                          Description                                     │
│ ───────────────────────────────────────────────  ─────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ npx forgedock                                    Guided setup: install commands + configure repo │
│                                                  (default)                                       │
│ npx forgedock guide                              How the workflow fits together: core commands,  │
│                                                  issue -> staging -> main, where a run ends, how │
│                                                  to resume                                       │
│ npx forgedock install                            Install commands to ~/.claude/                  │
│ npx forgedock init                               Generate forge.yaml config for your project     │
│ npx forgedock init --minimal                     Generate a minimal forge.yaml (required         │
│                                                  sections only)                                  │
│ npx forgedock enable [dir]                       Activate ForgeDock in a directory               │
│ npx forgedock disable [dir]                      Opt a directory out of ForgeDock                │
│ npx forgedock fix-close-reasons <owner/repo>     Re-close issues that were closed not planned    │
│ [--milestone <m>] [--apply]                      but carry workflow:merged or                    │
│                                                  workflow:decomposed (delivered, not dropped) as │
│                                                  completed, with a comment; dry run unless       │
│                                                  --apply; workflow:invalid issues are never      │
│                                                  touched                                         │
│ npx forgedock status [dir]                       Show ForgeDock state for a directory            │
│ npx forgedock run <cmd> [args]                   Run a command headlessly (local claude CLI or   │
│                                                  Anthropic API)                                  │
│ npx forgedock bootstrap <idea|docs> [--dry-run]  Headless /bootstrap: idea to orchestrate-ready  │
│ [--spike <path>] | --plan <plan.json>            backlog (--dry-run previews milestones, titles, │
│ [--dry-run]                                      DAG and estimated agent cost without GitHub     │
│                                                  writes); --plan validates and creates (or       │
│                                                  previews) a plan, and re-running resumes from   │
│                                                  GitHub                                          │
│ npx forgedock run-issue <issue> [--lane <lane>]  Run the lean core work-on on one issue          │
│ [--lane-override] [--path core|full] [--retry]   (default; --path full = legacy multi-phase      │
│ [--wait-lease]                                   pipeline; the lane comes from the issue:        │
│                                                  milestone → milestone/<slug>, else staging;     │
│                                                  --lane is an assertion, never the default       │
│                                                  branch) (--retry reopens an engine-error run,   │
│                                                  or a needs-human run once the label is cleared; │
│                                                  --wait-lease waits for a held lease; exit 75 =  │
│                                                  deferred, lease held)                           │
│ npx forgedock plan validate --live [--repo       Re-run the bootstrap dependency-order rules on  │
│ owner/repo] [--json]                             live GitHub state: each cross-milestone         │
│                                                  Depends-on edge is ok, held or invalid (exit 1  │
│                                                  on invalid)                                     │
│ npx forgedock orchestrate <issue...>             Run core work-on on several issues with bounded │
│ [--parallel K] [--lane L]                        concurrency and Depends-on ordering; each issue │
│                                                  on its own lane, cross-lane dependencies        │
│                                                  reported                                        │
│ npx forgedock orchestrate --resume <id> [N...]   Reattach to a batch hosted by the schedd daemon │
│ | --set-parallel <id> K | --set-max-remote <id>  (a finished one replays its report, an orphaned │
│ N | --set-placement <id> remote|hybrid|local |   one is resumed with live lanes re-adopted),     │
│ --add <id> N... | --requeue <id> N... [--reason  change its concurrency live, change its         │
│ "..."] | --cancel <id> | --hold <id> N... |      max_remote or placement mode live               │
│ --release <id> N... | --show-env <id> |          (remote/hybrid need a batch started with a      │
│ --set-env <id> KEY=VAL | --unset-env <id> KEY    remote provider; running lanes are not          │
│                                                  stopped), add issues to a running (or held)     │
│                                                  batch under its K and DAG, requeue a terminal   │
│                                                  issue (and the dependents skipped behind it)    │
│                                                  after an operator decision (refused while it is │
│                                                  labelled needs-human or closed; a finished      │
│                                                  batch is reopened), or stop one batch without   │
│                                                  stopping schedd (running lanes torn down with   │
│                                                  their work saved, the rest held for --resume),  │
│                                                  or hold/release single issues of a batch (a     │
│                                                  held issue is not admitted until released or    │
│                                                  named by --resume), or print (secrets           │
│                                                  redacted), set or unset a batch's pinned lane   │
│                                                  env (applies to newly launched lanes)           │
│ npx forgedock triage <issue...> [--lane L]       Already-fixed pre-filter: close issues a merged │
│ [--dry-run]                                      PR or green CI already resolved; print the rest │
│ npx forgedock probe [issue...] [--dry-run]       Run declared acceptance probes for closed       │
│                                                  issues whose fix is on the default branch; a    │
│                                                  fail reopens the issue                          │
│ npx forgedock check [--base REF] [--json]        Run the lane's frozen validate commands and     │
│                                                  change-scoped pre-PR checks locally in this     │
│                                                  worktree, as the engine will (no GitHub, no     │
│                                                  Actions)                                        │
│ npx forgedock milestone train <slug...>          Unattended multi-milestone train: one durable   │
│ [--parallel-milestones N] | --resume <id> |      state file (order, active set, lifecycle),      │
│ --insert <id> <slug> [--before s|--after s] |    typed STOP reasons, resumable; never edits      │
│ --show <id>                                      forge.yaml                                      │
│ npx forgedock guards list [--path p] [--json] |  Fix guards: list the FORGE:GUARD records (test  │
│ backfill --since <date> [--dry-run]              files + protected hunks of merged fixes)        │
│                                                  covering a path, or build them for              │
│                                                  already-merged lean lanes                       │
│ npx forgedock issue-watch run [--name <w>]       Named, scoped, capped watches (forge.yaml       │
│ [--repo owner/repo] [--once] [--dry-run] |       issue_watch.watches) that claim matching open   │
│ status [--name <w>]                              issues into lanes or one long-lived orchestrate │
│                                                  batch, or (mode: release) pool them and cut     │
│                                                  themed releases; see docs/ISSUE-WATCH.md        │
│ npx forgedock selftest [--static] | --live       Live contract harness: drives the real gh, git  │
│ --repo <owner/sandbox> [--lang node|python]      and orchestrate through a disposable sandbox    │
│ [--pr <N>] | --journey [--repo <owner/sandbox>]  repo (steps create, add, body, resume, merge,   │
│ [--pr <N>] [--update-snapshots]                  remote, cleanup) plus a static check of every   │
│                                                  gh --json field list; exits non-zero naming the │
│                                                  failed step; --pr posts the FORGE:SELFTEST      │
│                                                  result the staging->main review requires;       │
│                                                  --journey runs the packed CLI as a new user     │
│                                                  (clean environment, then a sandbox repo to a    │
│                                                  merged PR) and posts FORGE:JOURNEY; see         │
│                                                  docs/SELFTEST.md                                │
│ npx forgedock prod-watch run [--repo             Production-side watcher (forge.yaml             │
│ owner/repo] [--once] [--interval <s>]            prod_watch): read-only signal sources -> triage │
│ [--dry-run] | status                             -> governor -> issues, kill-switch file, owner  │
│                                                  digest; see docs/PROD-WATCH.md                  │
│ npx forgedock limits show | clear <id>|--all     Show or clear per-account usage-limit holds     │
│                                                  shared by orchestrate batches                   │
│ npx forgedock decisions list [--stale]           List anchored decisions (FORGE:DECISION);       │
│ [--refresh]                                      --stale shows those with an anchor missing on   │
│                                                  the base                                        │
│ npx forgedock sched show | cap <N>|--clear |     Show the host lane registry, set the host-wide  │
│ weight <owner/repo> <N>|--clear                  lane cap shared by orchestrate batches, or set  │
│                                                  a repo's share of slots within a priority       │
│                                                  (default equal)                                 │
│ npx forgedock schedd [status | watchdog]         Host scheduler daemon hosting every orchestrate │
│                                                  batch (auto-spawned by orchestrate; run in the  │
│                                                  foreground for a systemd-user unit); status     │
│                                                  shows its pid, batches and last tick; watchdog  │
│                                                  restarts a stalled daemon                       │
│ npx forgedock pool router [install] | enroll     Built-in remote compute pool: run the router    │
│ [--cpus N --mem GB] | status | upgrade [agent]   (foreground, or install it as a user service),  │
│ | remove <agent>                                 print the one-time install command for a host,  │
│                                                  list agents, upgrade or remove them             │
│ npx forgedock gc [--apply] [--older-than 6h]     Report (dry-run default) and reclaim            │
│ [--docker] [--worktrees] [--branches] [--tmp]    ForgeDock-owned leftovers: stale lane ledgers,  │
│ [--processes] [--sandboxes]                      forgedock-labelled containers/volumes,          │
│                                                  lean-*/agent-* worktrees, abandoned lane        │
│                                                  branches, ~/.forge<path> scratch, orphaned lane   │
│                                                  processes, orphaned lane sandboxes; unowned     │
│                                                  resources and unpushed work are only reported   │
│ npx forgedock resume-stalled [--dry-run]         Fleet stall recovery — re-dispatch              │
│                                                  expired-lease issues                            │
│ npx forgedock demo                               Set up a risk-free demo repo and print next     │
│                                                  steps                                           │
│ npx forgedock labels [setup] [--repo             Bootstrap ForgeDock-managed labels on a GitHub  │
│ owner/repo] [--domain a,b,c]                     repo, plus optional per-repo domain labels      │
│                                                  (idempotent)                                    │
│ npx forgedock config migrate [dir]               Backfill missing optional sections into an      │
│                                                  existing forge.yaml (idempotent)                │
│ npx forgedock watch [--repo owner/repo]          Live per-agent orchestration view (Ctrl+C to    │
│                                                  exit)                                           │
│ npx forgedock report [--days 30] [--md]          30-day pipeline impact receipts for your repo   │
│ [--json]                                                                                         │
│ npx forgedock review-staging [<PR>]              Staging->main review pre-dispatch: route        │
│ [--thorough] [--json]                            marker, open-finding gate, scope, prepare,      │
│                                                  roster; writes one reviewer brief per domain    │
│ npx forgedock review-staging [<PR>] --finalize   Staging->main review post-dispatch: delivery,   │
│ --test-gate-output <file>                        test-gate verdict,                              │
│                                                  extract/classify/file-prepare; prints the       │
│                                                  findings to file                                │
│ npx forgedock review-staging [<PR>] --summary    Staging->main review Phase 8: verdict and       │
│ [--filed <N>]...                                 summary comment with the FORGE:GATE_PASS /      │
│                                                  FORGE:GATE_FAILURE marker                       │
│ npx forgedock release [--repo owner/repo]        Staging->default release as one resumable job:  │
│ [--merge] [--watch] [--resume <id>] | release    preflight, release PR, review, fixes, promotion │
│ verify <sha> [--repo owner/repo]                 (stops at GATE_PASS unless --merge or           │
│                                                  release.auto_merge), post-merge; release.mode:  │
│                                                  snapshot cuts release/<id> from staging (lanes  │
│                                                  keep merging, fixes are cherry-picked,          │
│                                                  FORGE:RELEASE records them); verify checks a    │
│                                                  release head against that record                │
│ npx forgedock stats [--since <ver|date>]         Version-over-version cost/time/flow/review/gate │
│ [--repo owner/repo] [--json] [--refresh]         report from GitHub telemetry (no model)         │
│ npx forgedock stats --self-filed [--repo R]      Share of new issues the pipeline filed itself,  │
│ [--since D]                                      by kind, against the 15% target (#5207)         │
│ npx forgedock stats --conformance-outcomes       Read-only: do conformance blocks predict        │
│ [--repo owner/repo] [--since <date>]             post-merge defects (2x2 per repo, failure kind  │
│ [--window-days 7] [--replay <pr,...>             and risk surface; --replay a PR list against an │
│ --enforce-domains <list>]                        enforce config)                                 │
│ npx forgedock stats --depth [--since             Light-eligible vs ineligible lane outcomes, by  │
│ <ver|date>] [--min-n N] [--offline] [--repo      reason/signal, and the #5052 light-lane         │
│ owner/repo] [--json]                             promotion verdict                               │
│ npx forgedock doctor                             Check installation health                       │
│ npx forgedock doctor --fix                       Auto-fix deterministic issues (symlinks, hook,  │
│                                                  labels, legacy block) and reclaim               │
│                                                  ForgeDock-owned leftovers (forge.yaml hygiene   │
│                                                  TTLs)                                           │
│ npx forgedock doctor --lanes                     Lane preflight: pool token, pool agent version, │
│                                                  PATH shim loops, gh --json fields; prints every │
│                                                  check pass/fail                                 │
│ npx forgedock update                             Pull latest & reinstall                         │
│ npx forgedock uninstall                          Remove commands                                 │
│ npx forgedock opencode install                   Install token-efficient native OpenCode         │
│                                                  commands                                        │
│ npx forgedock opencode status                    Check the OpenCode adapter                      │
│ npx forgedock opencode uninstall                 Remove ForgeDock-owned OpenCode files           │
│ npx forgedock version                            Print the installed version and check for       │
│                                                  updates                                         │
│ npx forgedock help                               Show this help                                  │
│                                                                                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

╭───────────────────────────────────────────── Flags ──────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Flag               Description                                                                   │
│ ─────────────────  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ --fast             Skip animation/motion                                                         │
│ --manual           Plain text prompts instead of the review screen (init)                        │
│ --verbose          Show detection sources for every field (init)                                 │
│ --minimal          Generate a minimal forge.yaml with required sections only (init)              │
│ --refresh-context  Regenerate review.context/tech_stack from manifests and show a diff for       │
│                    approval (init)                                                               │
│ --version, -v      Print the installed version and check for updates                             │
│                                                                                                  │
